data.description: ResearchForge — search academic literature, download open-access PDFs, screen papers, and generate citations

sections.name: quickstart
sections.description: Core workflow — no project setup needed. Run these three commands to search, fetch, and cite.

commands.description: Search papers across sources and write results.jsonl + manifest to <dir>. Use --queries for multi-query batch. Sources preset: openalex,arxiv (fast), scholarly-fast, all (44 sources), biomedical, preprints, open.
Download open-access PDFs for all papers in <dir>/results.jsonl. Writes PDFs to <dir>/pdfs/.
Generate CITATIONS.md numbered bibliography from all downloaded PDFs across topic subdirs. Fetches metadata from Crossref and arXiv.

sections.name: search
sections.description: Search academic sources and manage results.

commands.description: Batch search: one or more queries across one or more sources. Writes results.jsonl, raw/, manifest.json, and optionally search-stats.txt.
Show hit counts per source and library record count for a search output dir.
Retry any failed queries recorded in <dir>/failures.jsonl.
Single-source search (openalex, arxiv, crossref, semantic-scholar, europepmc, pubmed, and 38 more).
Download open-access PDFs for papers in <dir>/results.jsonl. Skips already-downloaded files.
Check open-access availability of a single DOI (Unpaywall).
Show the full open-access resolution plan for a DOI without downloading.
List all configured open-access resolver sources.

sections.name: citations
sections.description: Bibliography generation and citation graph expansion.

commands.description: Build CITATIONS.md from all downloaded PDFs across topic subdirs. Default output: <dir>/CITATIONS.md.

commands.usage: rforge citations expand --source semantic-scholar|openalex|crossref --paper <id> --direction references|citations|both --depth N --out <file>
commands.description: Build a citation network graph around a seed paper.
Summarize a citation graph as a markdown report.
Find papers appearing in multiple topic subdirs. Use --min-topics 2 to see cross-topic core cluster.

sections.name: vault
sections.description: Obsidian vault export — turn research dirs into an interconnected knowledge base.

commands.description: Write one Obsidian-compatible .md note per paper (YAML frontmatter + [[wikilinks]]), per-topic index notes, and index.md with cross-topic paper highlights.

sections.name: obsidian
sections.description: Install and launch Obsidian for local research knowledge-base browsing.

commands.description: Download and install Obsidian for your platform (Linux: AppImage to ~/.local/bin/obsidian). Use --dry-run to preview without downloading.
Open a vault directory in Obsidian. If Obsidian is not installed, suggests rforge obsidian install.

sections.name: screening
sections.description: Title/abstract screening workflow (CSV-based, no project required). Screen before oa fetch to reduce download volume.

commands.description: Emit pending papers as a self-contained CSV with title, abstract, doi, authors, year for offline reviewer decisions.
Import reviewer decisions from a filled-in queue CSV into <dir>/screening.jsonl. Blank decision rows are skipped. Last-write-wins on re-import.
Show include/exclude/uncertain/pending counts from <dir>/screening.jsonl.

sections.name: project
sections.description: Full auditable systematic review project (optional; required for forge/screening/evidence workflows).

commands.description: Create a ResearchForge project with manifest, lockfile, database, and provenance log.
Show project health and workflow state.
List all ResearchForge projects under <root>.
Search batch within a project (imports records into project library).
Configure screening workflow with allowed exclusion reasons.
Record a single screening decision (project workflow).

sections.name: library
sections.description: Import, export, and manage the paper library.

commands.description: Import papers into the project library from external formats.
Export the project library to a format.
List all papers in the project library.
Report duplicate papers in the library.

sections.name: knowledge
sections.description: Knowledge graph query over parsed project content.

commands.description: Query the project knowledge graph.
Find a path between two nodes in the knowledge graph.
Show the paper relationship graph for the current project.

sections.name: utilities
sections.description: Diagnostics, governance, version, and environment checks.

commands.description: Print rforge version, commit, and build date.
Check local environment (pdftotext, network, services).
Show or set the automation policy for irreversible actions.
Verify all unchecked TODO items are covered by owner decisions.
Run the completion audit against the todo and audit files.
Show this help. Use --json for machine-readable command catalog.
